findings.claim: Twilio FY2025 10-K 風險因素：客戶可能因價格壓力、預算限制或業務優先順序改變而改用替代方案，且競爭對手可能推出功能相近或單一功能、較低價的產品。
findings.excerpt: In addition, customers may reduce or delay spending on our products or substitute alternative solutions in response to pricing pressures, budget constraints or changing business priorities.

findings.claim: Twilio 10-K 稱持續投資 AI 能力，並提及在快速技術變動下持續創新。
findings.excerpt: We are continuing to invest in AI-powered capabilities, which we believe have the potential to enhance our offerings’ value to customers, as well as to automate processes and help our business run more efficiently.

findings.claim: Twilio SIGNAL 2026 推出 conversation layer，定位從純 CPaaS 轉向對話基礎設施。
findings.excerpt: Twilio SIGNAL 2026: the pivot from CPaaS to conversation infrastructure MarketAugust 6, 2026· 5 min read TL By Tsahi Levent-Levi Twilio just told the market it doesn't want to be a CPaaS anymore.

findings.claim: 業界人士稱透過 MCP 包裝與 AI 編排，品牌無需單一 CPaaS，可自動跨多供應商路由。
findings.excerpt: “With MCP wrappers and AI orchestration, brands don’t need a single CPaaS solution, and they can route across multiple vendors automatically. That’s a major shift, and a big disruption.”

findings.claim: Twilio Q1 2026 後管理層稱 voice AI 仍僅占語音量一小部分。

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋結果僅有二手/廠商來源且無可逐字複製原文，列為 clues：SIGNAL 2026 轉向 conversation layer；CX Foundation 稱 MCP 與 AI 編排使品牌可跨多家 CPaaS 路由（削弱單一供應商鎖定）；MEF 稱 SMS OTP 下滑、成長在 WhatsApp/RCS。未找到直接評估 AI 平台繞過 Twilio API 的分析。 線索 3 條，程式核實 2 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
